heading: Applicability of securities laws

tree.heading: Ownership interests
tree.text: The ownership interests of members of a risk retention group shall be considered to be—

children.text: exempted securities for purposes of section 77e of title 15 and for purposes of section 78l of title 15; and
securities for purposes of the provisions of section 77q of title 15 and the provisions of section 78j of title 15.

tree.heading: Investment Company Act
tree.text: A risk retention group shall not be considered to be an investment company for purposes of the Investment Company Act of 1940 (15 U.S.C. 80a–1 et seq.).

tree.heading: Blue sky law
tree.text: The ownership interests of members in a risk retention group shall not be considered securities for purposes of any State blue sky law.

notes.heading: References in Text
notes.text: The Investment Company Act of 1940, referred to in subsec. (b), is title I of act Aug. 22, 1940, ch. 686, 54 Stat. 789, which is classified generally to subchapter I (§ 80a–1 et seq.) of chapter 2D of Title 15, Commerce and Trade. For complete classification of this Act to the Code, see section 80a–51 of Title 15 and Tables.
